about_the_game:
You are playing as a knight that survived an assassination attempt and now you have to find out who wanted you dead.

Earn the trust of the people and hire followers to help you in your quest to take revenge.

                                                                             

Current Features:

  • Followers:

  • The most important about the game is the way you use followers. You can equip them with gear, weapons or different tools such as axes and hammers for woodchopping and building, as well as a pickaxe to mine ores. They can also go out and harvest resources such as food and flax for creating cloth materials.

  • You can hire followers to help you build structures. They will gather wood or stone to build different structures.

  • Crafting and workbenches: When you want to craft an item workers will automatically find any available crafting task and assist you in crafting any item you choose, if they have the materials for it.

  • Followers can go and hunt for you if you give them bows or they can farm crops if you equip them with a farming hoe.

  • You can bring them to combat and they will help you fight enemies.

  • The game focuses on having a modular building system where you can build houses as you wish, as well as having predefined buildings like worker housing to make your workers rest between working. As well as lumberjack stations and mining stations for more effiecent gathering.

  • Survival Mechanics: Gather resources like wood, stone, and different ores to craft tools, gear and weapons and build structures,

  • Crafting: Craft armor ranging from cloth armor to wood armor.

  • Combat: Fight against evil bandits that are guarding resources.

  • Hunting: Hunt wildlife to survive. Hunt rabbits, wolves and boars for meat to cook for food.

  • Open world exploration: Explore an open world. The world will include a two square km big map.

  • Quests: Right now theres about 15 quests in the game, but planning on making a long questline with about 50 quests.

  • Explore different towns and biomes. Will have a snow biome to fight frost enemies. There is a desert biome that focuses on desert bandits. As well as a forest biome for hunting and wildlife.

Planned combat for the future:

  • Combat will include using tactics such as assigning formations and assigning ranged units for flanking units.

  • Gear and armor: Planning on adding bronze armor and weapons as well as iron armor and weapons.

content_descriptors.notes: The game will have combat and depiction of blood, like if you hit someone with weapons or hunt animals etc in the game.

name: Frontier Forge

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2gb
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Frontier Forge is an action RPG with survival and base-building elements. As a peasant, you must gather resources, recruit villagers, and craft weapons to defend yourself from bandits occupying the lands. Build your base, manage your people, and fight for freedom in a world on the brink of war.
